name: day-planner
description: Turns your own calendar into a day plan: today (or a day you name, up to 5 days) as an ordered agenda with each meeting's time, length, attendees, location or join link and a one-line context taken from the event's own description, plus the free gaps between meetings inside your working hours and the best focus block. It flags double bookings, back-to-back runs, unanswered invitations and meetings with no description. All times and gaps are computed in code. Read-only: it never creates, moves, declines or edits an event, and it does not read email or chat. Without a calendar connection it works on meetings you paste, one per line.

skills.name: Day plan
skills.description: Your calendar for a day as an agenda with context lines, free gaps, the best focus block and flags for double bookings, back-to-back runs and unanswered invitations. Read-only.
examples: when am I free tomorrow afternoon?
